steps.title: Getting started
steps.text:
Speak to Wizard Myrtle at the fountain near the entrance to the Wizards' Tower. (Fairy ring DIS)
  • For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, and game messages set to 'On' or 'Filtered'.
[Accept Quest]
Continue the conversation with Wizard Myrtle.

postconditions.text: Ah, it would seem I found the right person for the job then!

steps.title: Under the sea
steps.text: Talk to Vannaka south of the Edgeville bank.

postconditions.text: Then I will accompany you
We should both go and meet

steps.text: Return to the Wizards' Tower, and talk to Wizard Myrtle.

actions.text: How do I get to Mudskipper Point?

postconditions.text: Anything else?
Nope, I'm ready to go!
Nope, I'm ready to go!

steps.text: Make your way to Mudskipper Point, south of the Port Sarim lodestone.
Unequip your weapons and dismiss followers, then talk to Wizard Myrtle.

actions.text: I'd like to dive to the sunken island.

postconditions.text: Ok, you too Vannaka.

steps.text: East of the room, read the message in the bottle for the key and open the door.

postconditions.text: Maybe some of the islanders are still alive!
You open the door with the key you found.

steps.title: Anglerfish
steps.text: Talk to Brynna, the survival expert (directly to the south).

postconditions.text: Hmm, well I guess if I'm to break the curse I'll figure it out.

steps.text: Catch two raw shrimps.
Gather the seaweed nearby.
Cut a tree to get a soggy branch.
Interact with the boulder.

postconditions.text: The nearby steam vent roars into life as the pressure is increased.

steps.text: Cook both shrimp on the steam vent.
Boil only 1 shrimp again to burn it.
Talk to Brynna twice.

postconditions.text: I wish you the best of luck.

steps.text: Continue through the west gate.

steps.title: Jellyfish
steps.text: Go to the building to the west and talk to Lev, the master chef.

postconditions.text: *sigh* Fine.

steps.text: Go to the large jellyfish south-east of the chef's house and play the music box.

postconditions.text: PLAY ME MORE BEAUTIFUL SOUNDS!
DON'T KEEP ME WAITING!
Hmm? Oh sure, go ahead.

steps.text: Gather tasty seaweed.
Talk to the master chef again.

postconditions.text: Fantastic, go place the seaweed on the table over there and we can get started.

steps.text: Click prepare on the large table.

postconditions.text: You roll the seaweed out on the table.
Great, now we have the seaweed I am going to give you

steps.text: First - 1 up, 2 up, 3 up (Sweet, Sour, Spicy).

postconditions.text: mellow yet sour with some bitter undertones

steps.text: Second - 2 down, 2 up, 3 down (Mellow, Sour, Bitter).

postconditions.text: something spicy with a salty bitterness

steps.text: Third - 3 up, 1 down, 3 down (Spicy, Salty, Bitter).

postconditions.text: Fantastic, that's exactly what I was looking for!

steps.text: Continue through the west door to the small house in the north.

steps.title: Rockfish
steps.text: Climb down the ladder.
Talk to Dezzick, the mining instructor.

postconditions.text: I need you to make a bronze dagger. You'll need to mine some tin and copper ore, then use the furnace to smelt it.

steps.text: Mine soggy copper ore and soggy tin ore.
Add the ores to furnace.

postconditions.text: You add your ores to the furnace, but it doesn't heat them.

steps.text: Right click and close the doors.

postconditions.text: You close the furnace doors.

steps.text: Operate the pump and light the furnace.

postconditions.text: You pump the water out of the furnace.

steps.text: Retrieve the bronzish bar from the furnace.
Smith a bronze butter knife.
Talk to the mining instructor again.

postconditions.text: You should seek out your next tutor.

steps.text: Continue through the east gate.

steps.title: Swordfish
steps.text: Talk to Vannaka, the combat instructor.

actions.text: Sure, I'm up for a challenge.
Let's get on with the task.

postconditions.text: Don the blind fold I've wrapped around the hilt. Use only your senses to dispatch every giant sea rat that comes at you.

steps.text: Open the gate and click on the sword in the middle of the room to begin combat training.

postconditions.text: You close your eyes and begin to listen to your deepest senses.

steps.text: Click on the rats and other elements bouncing on the screen.
Exit the cage and climb the ladder to the north-east.

steps.title: Goldfish
steps.text: Talk to the financial advisor in the house directly to the east.

actions.text: Can we skip to the task?

postconditions.text: I'm sure if you rifle through Jed's notes you'll find some clues.
I'm sure there are clues to the code littered around the bank booth.

steps.text: Enter the vault (the code is 139).

postconditions.text: The vault door makes a clicking sound and swings open.

steps.text: Talk to the financial advisor again.

postconditions.text: Go and seek the next tutor. Take the east door out of the bank.

steps.text: Leave through the 2 doors to the east.

steps.title: Monkfish
steps.text: Head south to the church through double doors.
Talk to Brother Brace.

postconditions.text: Lovely, I held mass not too long ago so they shouldn't have strayed too far from the chapel.

steps.text: Backtrack to talk the fish on the friends list.

postconditions.text: Erm, I think I saw something
anchor east of the bank
the cannon to the west of the ladder to the caves
the coral east of the church
anchor east of the bank
the cannon to the west of the ladder to the caves
the coral east of the church
the cannon to the west of the ladder to the caves
the coral east of the church
around the anchor east of the bank

steps.text: Give the book to Brother Brace.

postconditions.text: Go with faith, my friend. You are walking a righteous path!

steps.text: Go through the south door to the south-east building and talk to Wizard Terrova.

steps.title: Moonfish
steps.text: Attack a chicken, then talk to the wizard.

postconditions.text: Welcome traveller. I can't help but notice that you let yourself into my house and bubbled my chickens uninvited.
How dare you try to break my curse. Come out here where I can see you!

steps.title: Commotion in the ocean
steps.text: Pick any option during the cutscene.

postconditions.text: Keep his minions off me and lend me your power when you're able!

steps.text: Channel the spell while repelling Crassians.

postconditions.text: You must put a stop to him

steps.text: Finish Hector Vivian.

postconditions.text: Bloop.
Arrrrgh curse you!
I'll round up the other tutors, we'll be right with you!

steps.text: Talk to Wizard Myrtle.
